items.title: Aphorism corpus + pure selection core
items.acceptance: a caller gets correct deterministic filtered selection over a >=40 entry corpus; same seed always yields the same aphorism, author/tag filters AND together case-insensitively, empty candidate set throws
items.notes: verified cycle 1 by 14 conductor-authored assertions; corpus n=50, mulberry32 seeded PRNG

items.title: Pure CLI argument parser + help text
items.acceptance: argv arrays parse into a correct options object; unknown flags, non-numeric seeds and value-less flags return a usage error instead of throwing
items.notes: verified cycle 1 by 19 conductor-authored assertions; builder also added stray-positional-arg rejection beyond spec

items.title: CLI entry point wiring corpus + select + args
items.acceptance: node bin/aphorism.js prints one attributed aphorism to stdout and exits 0; --list/--json/--help/--seed/--author/--tag behave per Domain rules; no match exits 1 with stderr only
items.notes: conductor-owned; verified by 11 end-to-end process-level tests asserting real stdout/stderr/exit codes

items.title: README documenting install-free usage and every flag
items.acceptance: README shows how to run without installing and documents all six flags plus exit codes
items.notes: conductor-inline; polish-docs workflow never dispatched (SMOKE clock)

items.title: No-repeat-until-exhausted rotation cursor
items.acceptance: consecutive unseeded runs never repeat an aphorism until the corpus is exhausted
items.notes: the taste fix from the kickoff critique; never dispatched — out of reach on a 25-min SMOKE clock. Carried forward deliberately, not dropped.

items.title: Human audit of corpus attributions
items.acceptance: every one of the 50 aphorisms is confirmed against a primary source or re-attributed to Anonymous
items.notes: filed at WRAP_UP; no automated check can settle attribution accuracy — named in REPORT.md hand-off as the largest correctness risk
